Description.SourceString: Did you know that, for a short period in the First Age, time was once measured in Krill Hours? If watches existed back then, you would have been able to set it by the migratory patterns of krill. The dominant shoal would take precisely one hour to pass from one side of Bramblemead Valley, round Temple Woods, to the other side of Bramblemead.  Children would often try to match their speeds, attempting to see who could notch up the greatest KH (krill hours).
